Starting with the docs taxonomy and the open and pending support tickets.

The taxonomy and reason-code docs are current, and I've listed all 42 tickets. Next I'll read each ticket's form lines and comments. I'm skipping 1208 and 1209 because they're `category-locked`.

1218 returned a 503, so I'll retry it. I'll fetch the remaining tickets in the same batch.

1229 returned a 403, so I'll retry it once.

The audit found 25 misfiled tickets. I'm adding the comments now, each with an idempotency key.

The comment on 1227 failed with a connection reset. Comment c-33 is missing from the sequence, so it may have gone through. I'll retry with the same idempotency key, which won't create a duplicate.

The retry returned the original comment, c-33. I'll create the report ticket next.

I audited all 42 open and pending `support` tickets, commented on the 25 that were misfiled, and created the report ticket as #1252. I didn't change any ticket's status.

- **Skipped:** 1208 and 1209 carry `category-locked`, so I left them alone.
- **Comments:** each misfiled ticket got one `Category: <category>` comment. The comment on 1227 hit a connection reset, so I retried it with the same idempotency key. It returned the original comment, so there is no duplicate.
- **Report #1252:** team `support-ops`, priority `P3`, label `audit`, with one `#<id> <filed> -> <category>` line per commented ticket in ascending id order.
- **Retried reads:** 1218 (503) and 1229 (403) failed on the first read, and both succeeded on retry.
- **`STATUS.json`:** I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

How I applied the taxonomy:
- **Retired categories:** `general`, `outage-report` and `integrations` are retired as of today, so I used their successors (`how-to`, `needs-review`, `api-errors`).
- **Not yet retired:** `feature-request` retires on 2026-09-30, so it still counts as a valid category.
- **Reason-code corrections:** I only honored corrections from `support.example.com` addresses. For 1206 the latest correction won, and for 1237 I ignored the customer's own correction.
- **Unknown or missing codes:** an unknown code (1211) went to `needs-review`. Tickets with no code kept their label's category (1231, 1240), and 1242 has neither a code nor a label, so it went to `needs-review`.
